# Pariññāvāra (Ya 7.2.4)

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Pariññāvāra* ("Section on Full Understanding" or "Penetration") is the fourth section of the *Anusayayamaka*, which constitutes the seventh treatise of the canonical Abhidhamma text *Yamaka* [Nyanatiloka 2007; SuttaCentral]. In the overall schema of the *Anusayayamaka*, it follows the section on abandoning biases (*pajahana-vāra*) and precedes the section on abandoned biases (*pahīna-vāra*) [Nyanatiloka 2007]. More broadly across the *Yamaka*, the *pariññāvāra* represents one of the three standard structural divisions of Yamaka chapters, coming after the *paññattivāra* (delimitation of terms) and the *pavattivāra* (process) [Norman 1983; Anderson 1999; Ronkin, Early Buddhist Metaphysics]. In this division, the text systematically explores the extent to which a given individual or class of beings comprehends (*parijānāti*) the category under consideration, analyzing penetration (*pariññā*) as the penetrating insight attained at the stages of noble holiness [Nyanatiloka 2007; Norman 1983; Anderson 1999].

According to DharmaNexus, the text shares extensive formulaic internal text reuse with 59 other Pali texts across 26,318 matching passages, exhibiting its largest matches with immediately adjacent sections of the *Anusayayamaka*—notably the *Pajahanavāra* (Ya 7.2.3), *Sānusayavāra* (Ya 7.2.2), *Anusayavāra* (Ya 7.2.1), and *Pahīnavāra* (Ya 7.2.5)—as well as sub-commentarial works such as the *Abhidhammamātikāpāḷi* and *Pañcapakaraṇa-mūlaṭīkā* [DharmaNexus]. While SuttaCentral records no curated cross-language parallels, DharmaNexus identifies automatic cross-language alignments with northern Abhidharma works, including Asaṅga's *Abhidharmasamuccaya*, the *Saṃskṛtāsaṃskṛtaviniścaya*, the *Abhidharmakoṣabhāṣyaṭīkātattvārtha*, and the *Pañcaskandhaprakaraṇa* [DharmaNexus].
